subject: Upcoming subprocessor addition: TelemetryStream — dataflow & evidence request
messages:
From: Paul Novak <pnovak@cloudwave.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudWave Contracts <contracts@cloudwave.io>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:34 -0700
Subject: Upcoming subprocessor addition: TelemetryStream (dataflow + DPA link)

Hi Rishi / Kimberly,

Quick note to let you know CloudWave plans to add TelemetryStream Inc. as a telemetry/metrics processor for the CloudWave SaaS that will touch logs and anonymized traces for routing/observability. Proposed activation date: 2027-04-15.

What we can share today:
- Draft DPA appendix (attached: telemetrystream-dpa.pdf)
- High level dataflow (traces -> encrypted transit -> TelemetryStream EU cluster)
- Planned retention: 30 days by default with optional 90-day windows for aggregated metrics

We want to make this low-friction for you — happy to provide a security evidence bundle (SOC2 summary, encryption details, access controls). Can you confirm what evidence your team prefers, and whether Redwood needs a DocuSign DPA addendum?

Known impacts: TelemetryStream will process aggregated telemetry for EU customers. No customer PII is expected to be sent; see the DPA excerpt. If you need an onshore fallback during the first 30 days of rollout we can gate traffic by region.

Attachments: telemetrystream-dpa.pdf

Thanks,
Paul Novak
Head of Partnerships | CloudWave Systems
paul.novak@cloudwave.io
+1 415-555-0198

--

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Paul Novak <pnovak@cloudwave.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 12:05:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming subprocessor addition: TelemetryStream (dataflow + DPA link)

Paul — thanks for the heads up and the draft appendix. We appreciate the proactive notice. A few quick asks from our side to move this along with minimal friction:

1) Evidence we need prior to activation (preferred file types/links):
   - SOC 2 Type II summary or latest report (redacted OK)
   - Dataflow diagram showing ingress points, egress countries, and any third-party hops
   - Evidence of encryption-in-transit and at-rest (KMS/HSM details if applicable)
   - Access control list for staff/system accounts that can decrypt or view raw telemetry

2) Residency/egress specifics for EU data. Please confirm if any EU telemetry will be routed through non-EU regions for processing.

3) Retention and deletion endpoint: confirmation on API or process for removing specific tenant telemetry on request.

4) Temporary access windows: if TelemetryStream needs support access for debugging, we require an explicit time-limited access policy (e.g., 8-hour scoped session) and evidentiary logs.

5) Legal/procurement ask: if you require a DocuSign appendix, send the exact DocuSign link and the DPA annex id. We'll route to Legal.

Can you get us the SOC2 summary and a consolidated evidence bundle by Tue (2027-03-30)? If not, propose an alternative cadence. I'll loop in Kimberly and Lauren to track security and legal side.

Thanks — rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:33:50 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming subprocessor addition: TelemetryStream (dataflow + DPA link)

Rishi — thanks for the checklist. Attaching the initial evidence bundle and short answers inline.

- SOC2: summary attached in TS-evidence-bundle.zip (SOC2 summary + controls matrix, redacted).
- Dataflow: included diagram (see inside bundle) — EU telemetry enters eu1.cloudwave.io -> TLS 1.3 -> TelemetryStream eu-cluster -> no non-EU processing unless customer explicit opt-in.
- Encryption: We use a CloudHSM-backed KMS (AWS CloudHSM for eu-west-1) with per-tenant keys. Details: KMS key IDs listed in the bundle.
- Access: Access limited to SRE team via role-based sessions; all sessions logged to an immutable audit stream (links included).
- Deletion API: /api/v1/tenants/{id}/telemetry/delete — synchronous delete; documented in bundle.
- Temporary support access: we provide time-bound support sessions via Bastion with jump-host and recorded TTY logs.

Planned activation: 2027-04-15 (can pause for a 14-day hold if you need extra review).

Attachments: TS-evidence-bundle.zip
Links: https://drive.cloudwave.io/s/telemetry/TS-evidence, DocuSign: https://docusign.com/link/abcdef

Let me know if that gets you started. If helpful, we can run a 30-minute walkthrough with our SRE and TelemetryStream engineering next week.

— Paul
Paul Novak
Head of Partnerships | CloudWave Systems

Paul / Rishi — thanks for the updates and the evidence bundle. Summary and next steps from Redwood's side:

1) Security intake: I'll spin up a short review with Security (Rishi) and Platform (Lauren) tomorrow 09:30 PT to validate the bundle and the KMS claims. Please join if you can (30-minute slot).

2) Legal: we will review the DPA appendix. If DocuSign is needed, share the precise url (we saw the link Paul included). Legal will aim for a redline by EOD 2027-04-01.

3) Procurement: if TelemetryStream requires a PO for onboarding, please send the pricing/prorate schedule; procurement will route accordingly.

4) Minimal mitigations during rollout: we will ask CloudWave to enable EU-only routing for Redwoods accounts by default, and to hold activation for any accounts flagged as EU-residency sensitive. That hold can be lifted after a security acceptance note.

Action items for CloudWave / TelemetryStream:
- Upload SOC2 summary and controls matrix to our secure drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/secure/telemetry-evidence-upload (we have a folder ready).
- Provide KMS key IDs and example cipher suites used (TLS configs).
- Confirm the onshore fallback plan is actionable for at least 14 calendar days post-activation.

Attachments: subprocessor-checklist.csv

If we get the bundle in our drive today we'll aim to clear security review by EOD Tue and legal by Fri. Otherwise we'll request the 14-day hold.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Procurement & Vendor Risk | Redwood Inference
